description: Basogati ni e’yo ba Busoga ni, Uganda ngaa vu, Eyi Nile eto vu Jinja ngbangba.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lugbara courses (#132) with low confidence in Lugbara; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: E’yo **Busoga ka Eyi Nile eto vu ni.**
why.text: Basogati ni e’yo Jinja, Iganga, Kamuli ka Mayuge ni, eri ovu Bagandati ndi, te eri ere. Imba aku ba ni, geri ndizu ni, azi ni, ka ongo Busoga ni.

cards.title: Aku ba ni
cards.text: A’yo atibi ka aku bayi be Busoga alia.

cards.title: Ba ndi geri dria ni
cards.text: Ndi Jinja ni ani Bujagali ka Buvuma.

cards.title: Ba le e’yo ni ni
cards.text: Ndre e’yoyi Basogati ka Bagandati ere ni.

landing.audience: Ba Lugbarati a’yo ni etozu ni, aku bayi emu Busoga ni, ka ba ndi Jinja.
landing.first: Ngoni, ru a’yozu ka nde, vutia aku ba, nyaka, suku, sawa, vu, jo ka ruakini, alu alu.

cast.emma: Uji imba Basogati ndi geri dria ndraa
